about: Questions the team asked of the 2026 logs, each with the season.py command that answers it. Run 'questions.py check' against new logs to see which can be answered; 'questions.py answer' answers them all.

questions.question: How many pose updates does the back-right camera contribute per match?
How many vision pose estimates are accepted per match?
How long is each camera not sending frames while enabled?
How many times does the robot brown out per match?
How much charge do all the motors draw per match (A x s)?
How hot does the hottest drive motor get per match?
Which auto routine ran in each match?
When did the CANivore report errors?
How much energy does the robot use per match, from the power distribution panel?
How far does the robot drive per match (m)?
